mapper.select: select id as categoryId, name as categoryName, sort_no as sortOrder, active as isActive from category where active = true order by sort_no asc

SELECT m.id AS menuId, m.cat_id AS categoryId, m.name, m.price, mn.kcal, m.image_url AS imageUrl, m.sold_out AS isSoldOut FROM menu m join menu_nutr mn on mn.menu_id = m.id WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY m.cat_id ASC, m.id ASC
select id as menuId, cat_id as categoryId, name, price, description, image_url as imageUrl, sold_out as isSoldOut from menu where id = #{ menuId } and deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT t.name FROM menu_tag mt JOIN tag t ON t.id = mt.tag_id WHERE mt.menu_id = #{menuId} AND t.active = true ORDER BY t.id

SELECT i.id AS ingredientId, i.name AS ingName, role.code AS role, unit.name AS unit, mi.is_default AS isDefault, mi.can_remove AS canRemove FROM menu_ing mi JOIN ing i ON mi.ing_id = i.id JOIN common_code role ON mi.role_id = role.id LEFT JOIN common_code unit ON mi.unit_id = unit.id WHERE mi.menu_id = #{menuId} ORDER BY mi.sort_no

select op.id AS optionGroupId, og.name as name, groupType.code as groupType,
case when op.max_select = 1 then 'SINGLE' else 'MULTIPLE' end as selectType,
op.min_select as minSelect, op.max_select as maxSelect,
mop.sort_no AS sortOrder, op.required as isRequired
from menu_opt_policy mop
join opt_policy op on mop.policy_id = op.id
join opt_group og on op.opt_group_id = og.id
join common_code groupType on og.group_type_id = groupType.id
where mop.menu_id = #{ menuId } and groupType.code != 'REQUEST'
order by mop.sort_no asc

select
oi.id as optionItemId, oi.ing_id as ingredientId, oi.name as name, oi.add_price as extraPrice, oi.list_price as originalPrice, oi.amount as servingAmount, unit.name as servingUnit, opi.recommended as isRecommended, opi.is_default as isDefault, oi.sold_out as isSoldOut, ing.kcal as kcal
from opt_policy op join opt_policy_item opi on op.id = opi.policy_id
join opt_item oi on opi.opt_item_id = oi.id
join common_code unit on oi.unit_id = unit.id
join ing on oi.ing_id = ing.id
join menu_opt_policy mop on op.id = mop.policy_id
where mop.menu_id = #{menuId} and opi.policy_id = #{policyId}
order by opi.sort_no
